caseNameFull: Evans, Governor of Idaho v. Jeff D., Minors, by and Through Their Next Friend, Johnson

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 471 U. S. 1098.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Luvern Charles Johnson III, Esquire, of Pocatello, Idaho, be appointed to serve as counsel for respondents in this case.
